cards.name: Seluruh mahasiswa
cards.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mahasiswa FROM students

cards.name: Dropout / seluruh catatan (%)
cards.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='Dropout')/COUNT(*),2) AS dropout_persen FROM students

cards.name: Enrolled | hasil belum selesai
cards.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrolled FROM students WHERE status='Enrolled'

cards.name: Komposisi status | jumlah mahasiswa
cards.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS mahasiswa FROM students GROUP BY status ORDER BY mahasiswa DESC

cards.name: Pembayaran & dropout (%) | ukuran kelompok di bawah
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN tuition_fees_up_to_date=1 THEN 'Mutakhir' ELSE 'Belum mutakhir' END AS pembayaran,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='Dropout')/COUNT(*),2) AS dropout_persen,COUNT(*) AS n FROM students GROUP BY tuition_fees_up_to_date ORDER BY dropout_persen DESC

cards.name: Unit lulus semester 1 | rata-rata menurut status
cards.sql: SELECT status,ROUND(AVG(curricular_units_1st_sem_approved)::numeric,2) AS unit_lulus,COUNT(*) AS n FROM students GROUP BY status ORDER BY unit_lulus

cards.name: Beasiswa & dropout (%) | asosiasi historis
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN scholarship_holder=1 THEN 'Penerima' ELSE 'Bukan penerima' END AS beasiswa,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='Dropout')/COUNT(*),2) AS dropout_persen,COUNT(*) AS n FROM students GROUP BY scholarship_holder ORDER BY dropout_persen DESC

cards.name: Ukuran kelompok pembayaran | jumlah mahasiswa
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN tuition_fees_up_to_date=1 THEN 'Mutakhir' ELSE 'Belum mutakhir' END AS pembayaran,COUNT(*) AS mahasiswa FROM students GROUP BY tuition_fees_up_to_date

cards.name: Ukuran kelompok beasiswa | jumlah mahasiswa
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN scholarship_holder=1 THEN 'Penerima' ELSE 'Bukan penerima' END AS beasiswa,COUNT(*) AS mahasiswa FROM students GROUP BY scholarship_holder
